lowerings.detail: `try_process` returns `ControlFlow`, which Verus cannot destructure through the `Try` trait here; the residual is modelled as an explicit `Option<E>` out-parameter and the target still performs the residual-to-`Err` conversion itself.
The delegated `|i| i.sum()` aggregate is observed only through the narrow `result_sum_output::<U, T>` output law over the ordered Ok payload sequence.

completeness.anchor: &&& result_all_ok(into_iter_remaining::<Result<U, E>, I>(iter)) ==> exists|payloads: Seq<U>| result_ok_payloads_match(into_iter_remaining::<Result<U, E>, I>(iter), payloads) && result == Ok(result_sum_output::<U, T>(payloads))
completeness.description: Without the aggregate payload witness the all-Ok case only knows that the outcome is some `Ok`, so two accepted runs may aggregate to different values.
completeness.observable: result_all_ok(remaining) ==> exists payloads. matched && result == Ok(result_sum_output::<U, T>(payloads))

implementation.description: The first-Err residual is discarded and an Ok aggregate is produced instead of the accepted short-circuit error.
